steps.help: Step 1 of 4: Click the "Add New User" button in the top-right corner to start creating a new user account.
Step 2 of 4: Enter the user's email, name, role, and set an initial password. All fields marked with * are required.
Step 3 of 4: Assign countries or organizational entities to the user. Focal Points must have at least one country assigned to access data.
Step 4 of 4: Review all information and click "Create User" to complete. The user will receive their login credentials.
